producer_policy: The base commit identifies the checkout. Producer binaries include the uncommitted routing and format-20 changes; their exact SHA-256 values identify the tools used.

terrain.policy: Existing embedded OBCT3 surface from the recorded v19 map is reused byte for byte for contours, ascent and embedding.

landmark_section.policy: Both names and all article payloads are unchanged. Approach metadata is regenerated from current access rules.

peak_section.policy: OSM association, article identity, name, multilingual articles and photo are unchanged. The current serializer rebuilds the photo credit.

land_policy: The canonical demo corridor is landlocked. The recipe uses --no-land, with the schema natural.land renderer backdrop; source OSM inland water and landcover remain included. No global coastline dataset is used.
navigation: The graph is rebuilt from source permissions, directional access, barriers, turn restrictions and the current four device profile definitions. Geographic rendering is regenerated; byte identity with the previous rendering is not asserted.
embedding: The fixture recipe restamps Light and Dusk, appends the unchanged terrain, relocates the dark table and pads to a 512-byte boundary.
network: Source packages are digest-verified locally before the bake. The bake downloads no sources and publishes no fixture catalog.
